name: cct-academic-system
description: City College of Tagaytay academic records dashboard with Firebase authentication and realtime data.

scripts.deploy: npm run check && firebase deploy --project academicdashboarddata --only hosting,database
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.test: node --test tests/cache.test.js tests/record-concurrency.test.js tests/security-validation.test.js tests/academic-modules.test.js tests/firebase-safety.test.js tests/env-vault.test.js
scripts.test:security: firebase emulators:exec --only database,auth --project demo-cct-security --config firebase.security.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/firebase-security.test.js tests/server-security.test.js"
scripts.test:concurrency: firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-cct-concurrency --config tests/firebase.emulator.json "node --test tests/firebase-concurrency.test.js"
